# Ready-world save

The user created `fixture.sav` on Stellaris Cygnus v4.5.1 (revision 10), without mods,
on 2026-09-29. It starts paused on 2200.01.01 with United Nations of Earth as the
local human country. Its original name was `4.5.1 fixture.sav`.

The compressed save is 1,245,251 bytes. Its SHA-256 is
`21ee2d01c213ebd441bccf50a144967e3bfb32d907511efc9fc6e4c70ca8fa43`.
Its metadata lists installed DLC; the test uses the installed content with no mods.
Native copies the save into a private profile and never changes the source.

The live observer must establish world readiness, actual country identity and the
normal main-thread update stack. The save's metadata alone establishes none of them.
